title: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. (CVE-2026-118480)
description: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute malicious JavaScript in the victim's browser by manipulating the DOM environment. Exploitation requires user interaction, specifically the victim visiting a crafted webpage. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality and integrity but does not affect availability.
